sprites.name: Gardien du creuset
sprites.description: Massive broad adult with thick powerful arms and wide shoulders. A FULL sealed work biomask completely covers the face and mouth: broad angular basalt-black faceplate, curved bronze brow rim, two narrow amber visor slits and twin low cheek filters; thick black scalp tendrils tied low. Heavy black quilted work coat, huge dark brown divided leather apron, bronze shoulder and knee plates. Holds short heavy crucible tongs closed over a cool small dark cup; other hand supports its insulated handle. Strong planted stance.

Match its actual species anatomy rigorously, including the cranial dome, alien orbital brow folds, reptilian granular skin, no human nose bridge or human lips, and exactly FOUR distinct EXTERNAL fleshy mandibles framing a separate INNER toothed mouth. Two upper cheek mandible lobes each carry one short inward/downward tusk; two larger lower mandible lobes each carry one long upward-curving tusk. For exposed faces, the four fleshy lobes must be individually legible, slightly open in calm neutral expression. If a complete work mask is expressly specified in the individual design, keep that mask instead, correctly fitted over Yautja anatomy; the facial constraints apply to visible skin only. Keep body three-quarter RIGHT but turn exposed FACE three-quarter TOWARD VIEWER enough to clearly show all4 mandibles. Do not copy the photo's human clothing, scene, logos or watermark. Variants can change brow proportions, spots, scars and tendrils, but NEVER simplify this anatomy.
